title: Letter to Church Leaders in Eugene, Indiana, 2 July 1833
source_note: JS, Sidney Rigdon, and Frederick G. Williams, Letter with postscript by Newel K. Whitney, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to “Dear Brethren,” [Eugene, IN], 2 July 1833. Retained copy, [ca. 2 July 1833], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 54–56; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; JS Collection, CHL.
